Definition: from G3326 and G2795; to stir to a place elsewhere, i.e. remove (figuratively):--move away.
BiblicalUsage: Paul warns the Colossians not to be moved away from the hope of the gospel. The word pictures a building shifted off its foundation, and Paul's point is that the gospel is the ground we stand on, not a view we hold lightly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe steadfastness is not stubbornness: it is staying grounded where God put us, because the hope of the gospel is the only foundation that holds when everything else shifts.
